executive_summary: This official report evaluates the air quality in Mumbai for 22 September 2026. The status is normal, with an area average of 29 micrograms per cubic meter and a population-weighted average of 25 micrograms per cubic meter. Zero percent of the area exceeds the Central Pollution Control Board national ambient air quality 24-hour standard of 80 micrograms per cubic meter.
risk_context: While the area average remains within normal standards, 62 percent of the area exceeds the World Health Organization 24-hour standard of 25 micrograms per cubic meter. Identified hotspots include Chembur and Sewri driven by power plant sources, and Borivali East driven by background sources.
recommendations: Monitor emissions closely at the power plant sources identified in Chembur and Sewri.
Investigate background pollution levels and sources around the Borivali East hotspot.
Continue regular air quality assessments across Mumbai to maintain the normal status.
